findings.summary: Race: a pull_request_target run counts only after it posts its status (end of run); a pull_request run at the exact head SHA can pass the gate first, executing PR-controlled verifier inputs not covered by PROTECTED_FILES. Not a regression: the gate workflow already runs PR-controlled code on pull_request. Follow-up: wait while any unfinished pull_request_target run exists on the head branch, or drop the transitional pull_request trigger.

findings.summary: Run-linking residual risk: same-repo PR code with statuses:write can link an earlier successful run to the new head SHA; permanent if a PR-edited workflow with actions:write cancels the current run. Forks cannot.
